title: Evaluation of the shifted polynomial
statement: Let $\ell,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\mathbb{F}$ be the field with $2^\ell$ elements, let $\gamma\in\{0,1\}^n$, and let $r\in\mathbb{F}$. The polynomial $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}\gamma_i X^i$, with each $\gamma_i$ viewed in $\mathbb{F}$, evaluates at $r$ to $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}\gamma_i r^i$.
hypotheses_covered: An element $r$ of the binary extension field of degree $\ell$
